fact: Uptime Institute told OSIRIS that it has not certified the State's Diamniadio data centre as Tier III, the ADIE director's claim notwithstanding; it aligns with ANSI/TIA-942-A with a view to Tier III certification.
title: Le datacenter national du Sénégal n'est ni le plus grand d'Afrique de l'Ouest, ni certifié Tier III
